question: What is your typical project delivery timeline?
answer: Timelines depend on scope. Corporate websites typically take 7–14 business days. Custom Web Applications, ERP, and POS systems average 3–6 weeks. We work in 1-week agile sprints with working milestone demos so you see continuous progress.

question: Do we get 100% ownership of the source code and intellectual property?
answer: Yes, absolutely. Once final milestone payment is completed, complete source code, GitHub repository access, database schemas, and all deployment keys are transferred entirely to your organization with zero vendor lock-in.

question: Can you integrate local payment gateways (JazzCash, EasyPaisa, PayFast) and POS barcode hardware?
answer: Yes. We have built integrations with JazzCash, EasyPaisa, PayFast, Stripe, thermal ESC/POS receipt printers, barcode scanners, and weighing scales, ensuring seamless offline/online operation.

question: How do payment milestones and contracts work?
answer: We operate on transparent milestone-based contracts: usually 30% upfront upon kickoff, 40% upon beta demo/core feature completion, and the remaining 30% after user acceptance testing and final deployment.

question: What happens after the project is deployed? Do you offer ongoing maintenance?
answer: Every project includes 30 days of complimentary bug-fix warranty and handover training. We also offer affordable monthly maintenance packages covering cloud server monitoring, daily automated backups, security patches, and minor feature updates.

question: Can you upgrade or automate our existing legacy database or software?
answer: Yes. We frequently audit and modernize existing systems—migrating manual Excel spreadsheets to cloud databases, building automated WhatsApp notifications, or integrating third-party APIs into existing software without disrupting your active business operations.
